name: lune
description: Ground your agent's research in full-text papers from top-tier venues, with citation trails and vetted methodology guidance.

interface.shortDescription: Search full-text papers from top-tier venues and check claims against what they actually say.
interface.longDescription: Lune gives your agent a research corpus it can cite: full text from venues like NeurIPS, ICLR, ACL, CVPR, USENIX Security and IEEE S&P, the citation trails between them, and a curated library of methodology guidance. Search across many angles at once, pull full text, trace who cited what, and fact-check a draft sentence by sentence against verbatim quotes.
capabilities: Search peer-reviewed papers across top-tier venues
Read full text and trace citation lineage
